sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (her move loop): sprinting forward, leaning in, the rifle held level at her hip pointing forward, the jacket streaming back, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE RIFLE goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): the yellow-green electric rifle, as long as in image 1 - held upright, levelled at her hip or aimed forward as the pale figure holds it. The two spiky hair buns stay on her head. Only her: no sparks, no electric arcs, no lasers, no bullets, no glow; the rifle does not glow outward.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, her brown boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the hair buns, the jacket and the rifle follow the pale figure.
